topics.name: DWH Instance Data Isolation
topics.purpose: Define local DWH data isolation at the full `#UM` instance boundary and explicit instance binding (`local` or `relation`) so data cannot leak across module instances by shared schema/name alone.

semantics.isolation_rule: Local data is scoped to the full UserModule instance identity.
semantics.local_rule: Local binding belongs to the current explicit module instance.
semantics.relation_rule: Relation binding requires a predeclared canonical relation/foreign-key binding.
semantics.schema_rule: Sharing a schema does not imply sharing instance data.
semantics.name_rule: Same field/entity/display names across instances do not merge data.
semantics.remote_rule: Remote data remains origin-scoped and is not silently absorbed into local instance storage.

invariants.rule: DWH data movement preserves explicit origin identity, schema, scope and remote authority boundaries; transport connectivity never becomes data authority.

hard_gates.condition: data shared across UM instances merely because schema matches
relation binding created without predeclared relation
remote data silently persisted as local identity

references.purpose: DWH local data is scoped to full UM instance.
